name: Peer Project Research
description: Research a peer project in the git identity management space. Search the web for recent releases, features, and documentation. Compare their approach to RemoteJuggler's. Write findings as a GitHub Discussion post with specific feature gaps or integration opportunities.
process: Peer projects to rotate through: git-identity-manager, gitswitch, git-users, onefetch, gitmux, git-credential-manager
Use web_search to find recent activity, releases, and documentation for one peer project
Use web_fetch to read specific documentation pages or changelogs
Use github_fetch to read RemoteJuggler's equivalent code for comparison
Post findings as a GitHub Discussion in tinyland-inc/remote-juggler with actionable recommendations

metrics.successCriteria: Discussion created with real web research citations (URLs that resolve)
